summary: Array Digital Infrastructure (f/k/a U.S. Cellular) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of select spectrum assets to Verizon for $1.0 billion in cash, following an October 17, 2024 agreement. Concurrently, the board declared a special cash dividend of $11.00 per share payable June 25, 2026 to holders of common and Series A common stock as of June 11. No premium or board recommendation details were disclosed. The transaction is a straightforward asset sale funded by cash consideration. Watch for potential shareholder lawsuits or tax implications of the special dividend; risk-arb focuses on execution finality.
